cases.name: a reviewed document round-trips byte for byte
cases.yaml:
# TomSpecs document (*.docspecs.yaml). Hierarchical format v2.
version: 2
modelVersion: "1.0"
document:
  DEMO Demo:
    TTL title: |2-
      Hello
    SUM summary:
      headline: |2-
        Executive Summary
      content: |2-
        Line one
        Line two

        Line four
    PRI priority: high
    CNT count: 3
    DET details:
      headline: |2-
        Details & Contacts
      content: |2-
        Captured during the November review.
        Owner: this line is prose, not the field.
      owner: |2-
        Bob
      contact: |2-
        bob@example.com
        - on call: weekdays
        - backup: alice@example.com
      estimate: 8
      weight: 2.5
      active: true
      priority: |2-
        high
    items:
      headline: |2-
        Work Items
      items-1:
        label: |2-
          First
        STS status: open
      items-2:
        label: |2-
          Second line A
          with ```triple``` ticks
        STS status: done
    REF-LST refs:
      REF-SPEC:
        headline: |2-
          Reference to the Spec
        content: spec §1.2
      REF-2: ADR7
    CARD-LST cards:
      CARD-ALPHA:
        headline: |2-
          Alpha Card
        content:
          note: |2-
            first card
      CARD-2:
        content:
          note: |2-
            second card
    META meta:
      OWNR owner: |2-
        alice
      tags:
        tags-1: |2-
          on
        tags-2: |2-
          no
        tags-3: |2-
          1:30
        tags-4: plain
    CTRL control:
      CTRL-SUM summary: |2-
        Controlled summary
      owner: |2-
        ctrl-owner
    NOTE notes:
      NOTE-BDY body: |2-
        Section-kind body
      remarks:
        content: |2-
          Wrapper-section text
review:
  "DEMO/NOPE":
    scope: keep
  "DEMO/TTL":
    comment: |2-
      Looks right; keep it as written.
    reviewed: true
    scope: keep
  "DEMO/items-1/label":
    comment: |2-
      First line.
      Second line.
  "DEMO/items-2/STS":
    scope: trim
    stop_here: true
  "DEMO/notes":
    comment: ok
